source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; Flora of North America (2003); Hatch, Tomas & Archer (2009), Journal of the Botanical Research Institute of Texas 3(2):965–967
accepted_infraspecifics: Bouteloua curtipendula var. caespitosa Gould & Kapadia
Bouteloua curtipendula var. tenuis Gould & Kapadia
synonym_and_rank_caution: Species-level POWO synonym list has six homotypic genus combinations, while the autonym variety has separate heterotypic synonym entries. Do not equate species-level name with an automatic variety determination.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; POWO-versus-2009 var. tenuis occurrence discrepancy recorded only as taxonomic source caution, no county/nativity edits
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — existing species photographs not authenticated to any of three varieties
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual plant ancestry independently demonstrated
install_decision: Existing canonical species retained; no installation, species/gallery/lesson changes

decisions.subject: Bouteloua curtipendula (Michx.) Torr.
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species and existing canonical binomial and authorship
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts species, first combination cited to Torrey in Marcy (1853). Canonical card matches.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua curtipendula var. caespitosa Gould & Kapadia
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve accepted variety at its proper rank without auto-assigning canonical specimen
decisions.detail: Accepted infraspecific variety, published 1964, distinct from var. curtipendula; not a separate accepted species.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua curtipendula var. curtipendula
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve accepted variety at its proper rank without auto-assigning canonical specimen
decisions.detail: Accepted autonym at variety rank; not interchangeable with other accepted varieties.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua curtipendula var. tenuis Gould & Kapadia
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve accepted variety at its proper rank without auto-assigning canonical specimen
decisions.detail: Accepted variety, published 1964; 2009 primary paper reports a Texas voucher despite POWO distribution summary listing Mexico only.

decisions.subject: Andropogon curtipendulus (Michx.) Spreng.
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as homotypic synonym of accepted Bouteloua curtipendula, not independent species
decisions.detail: Six species-level homotypic synonyms appear on POWO accepted species page; retain original name and authorship for source matching.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua curtipendula f. vivipara Beetle
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical forma to B. curtipendula var. curtipendula; do not create accepted forma or infer reproduction in photographed plants
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly synonymizes this forma under accepted var. curtipendula.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua curtipendula var. aristosa A.Gray
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety name to accepted B. curtipendula var. curtipendula, preserving original rank and author
decisions.detail: POWO accepted autonym page lists var. aristosa among heterotypic synonyms.

decisions.subject: Collapse all B. curtipendula varieties to the autonym
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; POWO/WCVP recognizes three accepted varieties, not one
decisions.detail: Species-level acceptance does not invalidate three accepted infraspecific taxa.

decisions.subject: Create independent species cards for historic Chloris/Dinebra/Cynodon/Atheropogon/Eutriana/Andropogon combinations
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject duplicate species concepts; treat six combinations as homotypic aliases
decisions.detail: The accepted species is Bouteloua curtipendula (Michx.) Torr.

decisions.subject: Existing learner gallery/specimen variety identification
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep variety identification unassigned pending a vouchered base, rhizome/stolon and flowering structure review
decisions.detail: Species-level photo IDs and general side-hanging racemes do not establish var. caespitosa, var. curtipendula or var. tenuis.

decisions.subject: Hybrid/introgression ancestry of any pictured sideoats grama
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not assert individual hybrid ancestry without specimen/genetic evidence
decisions.detail: Potential taxonomic complexity does not identify any canonical photographed individual as a hybrid.

decisions.subject: B. curtipendula var. tenuis — Texas distribution source mismatch
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep both sources visible; do not change any native-range/county field or reject the 2009 primary record
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP variety page lists Mexico only; Hatch, Tomas & Archer (2009) report var. tenuis new to Texas/USA. Source backbone distribution needs reconciliation separately; this is not a county nativity audit.
